1251-2105-7431-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
1251-2105-7431-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1251-2105-7431-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Daydream from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Daydream from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

483-1981-2415-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Defiant Salvager's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2023-4518-6006-7297.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4885-5078-6918-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

710-1258-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Abduction triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Abduction from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

2724-3217-3582-8095.description:
Activate Kaya the Inexorable's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting a ghostform counter on Wormfang Manta.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability and its ghostform ability trigger.
Resolve the ghostform trigger, returning Wormfang Manta from your graveyard to your hand and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
Repeat each turn.

586-864-2921-3125-7422.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2921-3125-7422.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Garrison Excavator.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

3532-5078-7010-7811.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
3532-5078-7010-7811.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Iron Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

129-1409-4927-6006.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

1575-4231-4826-7601.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Foods.
1575-4231-4826-7601.description:
Activate Insatiable Frugivore by paying {3}{B} and sacrificing at least four Foods.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers for each Food sacrificed, creating that many untapped Foods, Clues and Treasures due to Academy Manufactor and Archelos
Resolve the Insatiable Frugivore ability, giving creatures you control at least +4/+0 and menace until end of turn.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}.
Repeat.
1575-4231-4826-7601.notes: If you sacrifice five or more Foods each loop, you'll get infinite Clue and Treasure tokens.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2049-3259-6791.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2049-3259-6791.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ogre Chitterlord as attackers.
Ogre Chitterlord triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2292-2525-3763-6749.easyPrerequisites: You control at least six lands.
2292-2525-3763-6749.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Anticausal Vestige.
When Anticausal Vestige dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Body Double from your hand onto the battlefield tapped. Choose to have Body Double enter as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
When Body Double enters, Paleoloth triggers, returning Anticausal Vestige from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Body Double.
When Body Double dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Anticausal Vestige enters, Paleoloth triggers, returning Body Double from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1879-3490-6723-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
1879-3490-6723-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

4924-4955-7070.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature with base toughness 2 or greater.
4924-4955-7070.description:
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Grafted Wargear ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Heartless Summoning.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

2228-3108-4865.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Vesuvan Shapeshifter.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Vesuvan Shapeshifter by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness and that has power 1 or greater

262-413-549-4853.description:
Activate the creature with Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste equal to its power.
When the Elementals enter, Blasting Station triggers that many times, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing an Elemental.
When the Elemental dies as an artifact due to Biotransference, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping the creature with Elemental Mastery attached.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

339-677-4885-6797.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

339-677-4785-5256.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2957-4508-4772-5880.description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing Magmaw to become a Pirate until end of turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

687-1894-4929-5641-5684.notablePrerequisites: If Bile Urchin is in your graveyard, you must have {3} available and three removable counters from creatures you control, ensuring to leave a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite and Basking Broodscale. If Bile Urchin is in your hand, you must have enough mana to cast it.
687-1894-4929-5641-5684.description:
Cast Bile Urchin by paying its mana cost if it is in your hand. Otherwise, activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control, causing you to mill three cards and return Bile Urchin from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
When Bile Urchin enters the battlefield, Metastatic Evangel triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite and Basking Broodscale and a vigilance counter on Bile Urchin.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a vigilance counter on it.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing both vigilance counters from Bile Urchin and another counter from a creature you control.
Holding priority, activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
Resolve the Tayam ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Bile Urchin from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
Repeat.
687-1894-4929-5641-5684.notes: If you do not control any other creatures, you may instead activate Tayam before sacrificing the Eldrazi Spawn, thus using the Eldrazi Spawn's vigilance counter as the third counter for activation. Doing this will add {1} to the mana needed for the combo.

602-3591-5014-6282.description:
Activate Putrid Imp by discarding a card.
Necropotence and Feast of Sanity trigger.
Resolve the Feast of Sanity trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Necropotence trigger, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Putrid Imp ability.
Repeat.

791-2290-5902.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
791-2290-5902.description:
Activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting two +1/+1 counters on Spike Feeder.
Activate Spike Feeder's second ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat.

440-1339-3188-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-3188-5231.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

803-1429-2511-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
803-1429-2511-5402.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

864-2061-3617.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Time Walk each turn.
864-2061-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Eternal Witness.
When the Eternal Witness token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2-198-1057-1651.notablePrerequisites: Empowered Autogenerator has at least four charge counters on it.
2-198-1057-1651.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least four mana of any color.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Brimaz's first ability triggers, creating an Incubator artifact token.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Clock of Omens by tapping Ancestral Statue and the Incubator token, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Resolve the Ancestral Statue trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1461-3008-4659.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1461-3008-4659.description:
Activate Blade of Shared Souls' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to another creature you control.
Blade of Shared Souls triggers, causing the creature it is attached to to become a copy of Wurmcoil Engine.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the creature with Blade of Shared Souls attached, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, it triggers, creating two 3/3 Wurm creature tokens.
Repeat.
